footnotes.text: The use of carbon steel machine bolts is limited to use with cast iron flanges, where required by Code. Machine bolts or cap screws shall not be used with steel flanges.

Flange bolting materials for piping design temperatures above 1100°F shall be determined by the design engineer for the specific line class specification. ASME B31.3 listings for bolt materials in this temperature range are very limited, and typically have additional use restrictions as specified in the referenced notes in the code. Use of unlisted materials may be necessary as allowed by B31.3 paragraph 323.1.2. For example, see bolting in PIP Piping Material Specification 3SC0501.
